How many days will Andrew travel to Rochester and return to New Jersey? Andrew plans a road trip from New Jersey to Rochester. Traveling by bus from New Jersey to Rochester takes 6 days. Traveling by car from New Jersey to Rochester takes half as many days as traveling by bus. Andrew plans to travel to Rochester by bus and return from Rochester by car.
